propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets that are invisible to the acceptance criteria counter and cannot carry operator attestation tags
Success Criteria blocks must be migrated to Acceptance Criteria as checkbox items to make them countable and individually attestable
The migration script must process closed tickets by default and require an explicit flag to touch open/in_progress tickets to avoid silently invalidating in-flight plan-review attestations
The dry-run revealed an order-sensitivity defect where 97 of 104 tickets would be corrupted if SC preceded AC, fixed by order-agnostic block splicing
Post-migration verification confirmed all 106 migrated tickets meet the acceptance criteria floor and no Success Criteria headings remain in the store
